protocols.purpose: Individual-page schedule and handling details, transcribed as a research/educational reference
protocols.evidenceNotes: Secondary commercial source; the details below are the source's own statements, not independently verified clinical guidance. No validated regimen for this modified analog or parent. Page distinguishes rodent studies (~30–40 mcg/kg on five consecutive days/month) from market conventions for plain Epitalon (5–10 mg daily for 10–20 days); neither validates this amidate. 5 mg + 2 mL gives 2.5 mg/mL. Research only.

schedule.description: Rodent work reported on five consecutive days per month; not a human regimen. The 5–10 mg Epitalon convention is for a different, unmodified peptide.

regimen.notes: No validated regimen for this amidate. The structured amount is a rodent weight-based exposure only, not a human dose.
